candidates.video_description: The Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius is building optimistic momentum — but Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde simultaneously. The cosmic tension between expansion and revision is defining this week.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — and the Moon in Sagittarius is refusing to care. Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto all pulling inward, all asking you to revise, revisit, release. But a Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius wants to expand, explore, and say yes to everything. This is the tension of the week: your soul is trying to move forward while the cosmos is forcing a reckoning. Which direction are you actually going?

candidates.video_title: Mars and Jupiter Together in Leo — What It Means
candidates.video_description: Mars sits at 10° Leo and Jupiter at 22° Leo right now — both in the sign of performance, ego, and creative fire. This rare conjunction amplifies ambition, boldness, and the desire to be seen. But Leo energy cuts both ways.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — and that combination is not quiet. Mars at 10°, Jupiter at 22°, both in the sign that was born to perform. In astrology, Mars is your drive and Jupiter is your amplifier. When they share the same sign, ambition gets louder, confidence gets bolder, and the urge to be seen becomes almost impossible to ignore. The risk? Leo energy inflated without discipline becomes pure ego. Are you creating — or just performing?

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — Scorpio Season Depth
candidates.teaser: Venus retrograde in Scorpio isn't just about old lovers coming back — it's about something much darker and more personal than that.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — The Real Warning
candidates.video_description: Venus is retrograde at 5° Scorpio right now, with the Sun in Libra and Mercury approaching Scorpio's depths. This is not typical Venus retrograde energy — Scorpio transforms everything it touches, including what you think you want.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde in Scorpio doesn't bring your ex back — it brings back the version of you that let them in. Right now Venus sits at 5° Scorpio, moving backward through the sign of obsession, transformation, and everything we refuse to name out loud. In astrology, Venus retrograde asks what you truly value — but in Scorpio, that question comes with a scalpel. What you thought you wanted might be a wound wearing a disguise. What are you actually chasing right now?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 8th House — Scorpio's House Explained
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that astrologers call the most feared — and almost nobody talks about what it actually means.
candidates.video_title: The 8th House — The Most Feared in Astrology
candidates.video_description: The 8th house rules death, transformation, shared resources, and the parts of yourself you hide even from yourself. Often called the house of Scorpio, it's one of the most misunderstood placements in any birth chart.
candidates.script: The 8th house is the one placement most people fear to look at in their birth chart — and that fear is exactly what it's trying to teach you. Ruled by Scorpio and Pluto, the 8th house governs death, transformation, shared money, inheritance, and the psychological underworld you carry quietly. It's not cursed — it's concentrated. Planets placed here don't destroy you; they force a reckoning with what you can't control. What's in your 8th house might be your greatest power.
